title: Date A Live F Last Date Anime Reveals Film Format, March 26, 2027 Opening in Teaser Video
content: The " Fantasia Bunko Grand Thanksgiving Festival 2026 Online" event on Sunday revealed the anime film format and March 26, 2027 opening date for Date A Live F Last Date , the latest anime project for the Date A Live franchise . The announcement confirms the film is the "concluding arc" for the anime series.
author: ANN

title: 'Akane-banashi 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, Teaser Promo
content: The special livestream presentation for the television anime adaptation of Yuuki Suenaga and Takamasa Moue 's Akane-banashi manga revealed a pair of additional cast, key visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video for the second season on Sunday.

title: Nigozyu Plans to End The Detective Is Already Dead Novels in 15th Volume

title: Japan Honors Director Rintarō as Person of Cultural Merit
content: Rintarō 's real name is Shigeyuki Hayashi . The director is currently 85 years old. The director is in charge of the original story draft for Toei Animation 's new anime film based on Leiji Matsumoto 's Galaxy Express 999 franchise .

title: Land of the Lustrous' Haruko Ichikawa Launches New Manga Cosmic Mimimi
content: The December issue of Kodansha 's monthly Afternoon magazine announced on Friday Haruko Ichikawa will launch a new series titled Cosmic Mimimi in the next issue on November 25. The "neo kawaii sci-fi" series follows Mimimi, who lives in a "cool" and "dreaming" city. Its goal is to make everyone happy.
author: ANN

title: Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc Anime Gets English Dub on Crunchyroll
content: Crunchyroll announced on Saturday that it is now streaming an English dub for the first two episodes of the Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc television anime based on Yura Urushibara 's Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood manga. The announcement did not mention the English dub cast.
author: ANN
